summary: validate_argument_spec takes a required argument_spec dict (AnsibleModule-style) and optional provided_arguments to validate.
questions: How do I validate arguments I'm about to pass, not current vars?

answer_card.title: validate_argument_spec parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `argument_spec` (required): AnsibleModule-style options dict
- `provided_arguments`: dict to validate (otherwise current vars)
